desc:
Welcome to Chop a Bamboo Forest! 🎋

The Panda Bank's bankers ate their whole vault 🐼 and now they pay GOLD for every stalk you bring in. Can you slice your way to the Summit? ⛰️

Slice bamboo with your katana 🗡️
Bank your bamboo with the panda tellers for Gold 
Upgrade your blade and buy better katanas ⚔️
Clear 6 areas, from Bamboo Grove to Frostpeak Shrine 🏯
Reach the Summit and fell the Thousand-Year Bamboo 🌳
Unleash the Water Katana 🌊 and the Electric Katana ⚡
Hatch pets that boost every run 🥚
Find rare Golden and mutated bamboo ✨

Normal, Hard and HARDCORE modes 🔥
Play solo or with up to 3 friends 👥

LIKE & FAVOURITE FOR UPDATES! 👍

SOLO & FRIEND RUNS SAVE!
